review: 与其说是AVG，本作真就是严格意义上的视觉小说，甚至几乎完全舍弃了游戏性（如果说Extreme模式里那个“沙漠开车”成就也能算游戏交互的话）。与同类型的大多数作品一样，本作前半段也让人非常难以入戏，以至于我大概用了两个多月无数次用“买了还是要玩”来劝自己打开客户端，但是每次都最多只能坚持个十多分钟就以玩不下去关闭窗口告终。但是到了剧情后半段，这个实际上充斥着主人公之间互相心灵治愈的暖心作品也就理所当然地渐入佳境了，结果就是用一个晚上激情推完最后几乎一半的剧情，毕竟看到最后谁会不爱小天使Marina呢。最后一part的转折的确有些生硬，但结合人物性格理解的话也不显得那么突兀，只能说铺垫还是没做到位，结束得偏又稍显仓促。说起来最近出了新付费DLC，希望早日出官方汉化版。

I really love Highway Blossoms. It’s a such a special game that set off the founding of my favorite VN studio. They polished this game into a gem and have made so many fantastic games since. I recommend them all, but Highway Blossoms is the perfect starting point

My gold standard for this kind of character-oriented yuri VN is definitely "Seabed" or the "Flowers" series by Innocent Gray.  If you haven't read those, I'd pass on this one and just recommend those instead.

However, if you just want some yuri fluff with some relationship trouble and a character struggling with grief, it works pretty well. That's because "Highway Blossoms" is exactly that at its core.  The story itself is ridiculous (who on earth would let treasure hunters vandalize public parks like that?), but that's no biggie.  My expectations going in were not that high to begin with.

Whether you like this or not will depend on how you feel about Amber and Marina as characters.  If you don't like them, you'll probably not find this very enjoyable.  For me, though, Mariah was, by far, the best character here.  I'd have liked to see more of her.  

I did find this more enjoyable though than "A Tithe in Blood" if we're talking about other Studio Elan titles -- perhaps because it wasn't taking itself so seriously as that one and had more of an Americana theme.  The music in this really is quite good and reminds me of my childhood growing up in South in the USA.

A very good yuri romance novel. Sweet and fluffy for the most part, except for a little bit at the very end. The dynamic between the two leads is familiar, but well done. Marina is a ditzy, perky girl, and Amber is a grumpy straightwoman to her antics. There's also 3 other side characters who I like a little less. Mariah is an alcoholic fellow treasure hunter, who I think is a little too abusive to her friend Joe, and little sister Tess. Other than those 5, there are no real other characters of note, only the occasional side character who only exists to move the plot along. I'm not always a fan of adult content in my games, but I think it was nicely handled in this. There are only two sex scenes, and they definitely felt earned. And the scenes are nicely awkward as well. These two girls aren't porn stars, they''re still trying to learn what they like and dislike. I'll also give credit, there's one point in the sex scenes where I said "Oh, that's awful" out loud, and then one of the characters burst out laughing at the line. The one this I would put as a caveat to some people, is that, towards the end of the game, Amber can't come to terms with her own feelings, and snaps at Marina, in a way I found to actually be kind of cruel. This is eventually patched up, and dealt with, but if you've been in an abusive relationship, maybe you'd find it kind of triggering?

一部百合游戏的经典，现在很多的游戏打着百合的旗号，实际上只是（说重一些就是媚宅向）男性向后宫，不是在认真讲诉游戏人物的故事，单纯给玩家开后宫而已。这部经典就是给无奈看多了虚假百合的玩家的洗眼神作。
优点：这部经典，与其说是在讲述恋爱的同时，还将亲情、责任与自我认同等议题融入其中，不如说恰好相反，与marina的恋爱是amber不断面对“我到底为了谁”、“我能承担什么”以及“我真正想要的是什么”等等对自己的提问的果。
就像游戏后面在他们的冲突中，amber想明白了，marina不是她心中爷爷的替代品，她们是对等的，但她却一直在把marina当成孩子，爱是自私的，像是现实中中国式i父母对孩子的爱，深沉（沉重）不对等，看似是对外无私付出的爱反倒最难以让人接收，某银发没头脑加不高兴说的很清楚了，互相利用，互相依赖，这才能成为家人。包括我自己，从游戏的一开始给marina和amber打上的标签--没头脑和不高兴，直到冲突的高潮才幡然悔悟，我不知不觉也把marina当成了一直被保护如孩子般的下位。
最后英配顶级，背景音贴合游戏，三人组的设定也很巧妙，顶中顶的作品
毒点？：看评论很多人觉得赌黄金那里很莫名其妙，嘛嘛，其实如果我们从玩家的角度来看，感到莫名其妙没问题，但还是太现实了点，我过到那里的时候，本以为剧情的发展是主角把黄金全输掉了，然后揭秘marina的礼物到底是什么，最后二人虽然没了黄金但一起面对生活，幸福的过小日子。（虽然我还是不知道marina到底要给ab什么礼物）
我一直觉得黄金应该是偏向意象的东西，就像这场寻宝，所有人就通过这么和莫名其妙的日记开始了寻宝热一样，寻宝日记是引子，找到的黄金是情感，最后黄金给一直寻宝的三人组，一切就像梦一样，只有双方的情感留了下来，人就是最好的宝藏。
不过还是我像多了，虽然我觉得这种偏意识流，电波一点的结局也很好，但最终剧情还不是这么发展的。

I don't usually write reviews. But I feel like I need to for this game in case this is a dealbreaker for anyone else. I will try to keep this short. As a lesbian who is very passionate about girls love, I was really excited to play this VN. And, for most of the game, I was enjoying my time. I was actually enjoying it quite a bit. Which is why I feel the need to warn about the breaking point. When you get very close to the end of the game, Amber can't handle her own feelings and lashes out at Marina. And it's brutal. Horribly so. Marina did literally nothing wrong. And she kept trying to cheer Amber up and support her. But after every single line of Marina trying to help, Amber literally screams insults at her. It feels so abusive. It lasts too long. It feels horrible to sit through. And Amber, instead of actually trying to make things right, just sends Marina away. And you get a huge stretch of time with this unresolved before they make up and have sex. But by the time they made up I was so angry and clocked out that I didn't care anymore. If this doesn't sound like a dealbreaker, then you might still enjoy the game. But for me, it destroyed any positive feelings I had about the game. It sucks because I really wanted another girls love story to be attached to.

Highway Blossoms is a sometimes cute, sometimes emotionally uncomfortable, yuri story about two young women treasure hunting across the American Southwest.

After the death of her grandpa, her only real guardian, Amber is traveling in her RV to the California desert for a musical festival she and her grandpa were supposed to see together. Along the way, she sees a young woman, Marina, stopped on the side of the road, and pulls over to check on her. Marina's car needs gas, so they head to the nearest gas station, where Amber discovers that Marina (and many, many other people) are traveling around the Southwest in search of a recently publicized buried treasure. Feeling lonely after losing her grandpa, Amber decides to help Marina look for the treasure.

The early treasure hunting segments were the most enjoyable part of Highway Blossoms for me. Amber and Marina make for a great, banterful duo, and also find themselves in a rivalry with another group of treasure hunters, with whom they have many hilarious interactions.

Over the course of their journey, attraction slowly builds between Amber and Marina, and their interactions start to become a little quieter and more awkward. It's here where my enjoyment of the story started to slightly decrease, and it decreased even more during its melodramatic climax.

However, overall, I liked Highway Blossoms. Although the second half of the story killed some of the momentum from the first half, Amber and Marina are a fun pair, and it was fun to learn about some of the natural attractions in the Southwest.

7/10

[h1]角色刻畫到最生動有活力的一部治癒公路之旅[/h1]
體驗10年前的百合神作，最頂尖的角色塑造

[h3]題材[/h3]
公路旅行這個主題真的蠻特別的，在亞洲地區可能這類題材不太常見，而這次的舞台就是在美國西南部展開的，不論是文本構思還是配樂和口音，背景圖畫風都是美式文化風格為主但角色的設計偏向日系風格，有點像在看某一些老美劇的的體驗
[h3]配音[/h3]
他們採用英文配音，說實在的還蠻少看到這類的配音而且配音員是真的厲害開心時活力四濺、生氣時的撕心裂肺，一聽就能知道這個角色大概是什麼樣的個性，前幾句對話就能深深愛上角色的之間的互動模式，到了後期主角各種的情緒表現張力十足，在配音上真的能給這對主角靈魂，這次真的是配音吸引的

氣氛的營造，整體故事不會有太大起伏轉折，可能偶爾有一些小摩擦但整體故事的流程是輕鬆愉快的，而且爭吵和對峙的氛圍也營造的很到位，那種兩個人的小世界被營造的很細膩，如果厭倦了複雜的故事、難受的劇情那這款遊戲覺得是一個最好的解藥

This story is unbelievable. And sadly I mean that in the literal sense here.

None of the characters feel like actual people. Everyone's just a bit too exaggerated to be believable.

Every single characters core trait is exaggerated to a point where they don't feel like characters, they feel like vessels for drama and excuses for sh*t happening just to progress the story or create more drama.
While yes, obviously people are never perfect, I think the constant setups in this VN about the way people interact with each other is so far removed from reality that it becomes difficult for me to actually root for anyone.

It's so difficult to believe that Marina would be that stupid and that forgetful. (Also, really? "Nickel" being corrected to Quarter by Amber because she doesn't understand what 1/4th of something is??) The scene where she screams to not be treated "like a f*cking child" is not even believable because she's done nothing but ACT like a child for the entire game. It has no weight because she has genuinely not given me reason to believe she is anything but a child who could never take care of herself.

Mariah is a difficult case to express in simple words but her entire character feels like a joke, it feels like a mcguffin for the protag duo to have someone to bump heads with. Her animosity is dialed so high up that it's comedic but once again, it disconnects from reality. Joe and Tess both being completely passive towards it and putting up with it makes it all the worse cause it feels like the game itself doesn't even realize how silly it is. Also making her a raging alcoholic that goes as far as throwing bottles at them when she's hungover? She's abusive as hell and they just... don't seem to care?

It's difficult to believe how absolutely self absorbed Amber is for someone who's supposed to have dedicated herself to care for her Grampa (and then Marina), and yes I understand that she's a 19 year old girl who lost her only parental figure but the way she acts is still hard to believe sometimes. She's always right, she's always in charge. She's also abusive, in a much lesser degree, and it feels like the story completely skims over these aspects of the characters because they're just traits being used to forward a story that ends up feeling hollow.

The game was about a treasure hunt. That treasure hunt ends like halfway through the story. Two 19 year old girls have found A FORTUNE in gold and they just... don't seem to even care about it until it becomes relevant when Marina BETS THE ENTIRE THING AWAY (again, why the writers thought this would be good narrative I have no idea)

The treasure itself, the thing the game builds up around for the entire first half, becomes completely sidelined in the 2nd half, by interpersonal drama and convenient f*ck-ups that force the characters to be real people for brief moments.

By the ending, it's hard for me to feel for any of the characters, when none of them feel like real people to me. This feels like a bad comedy without a punchline.

It's already insane to me that these events even transpire like a 19 year old girl is suddenly away from home with no car and no phone and her immediate instinct is to beg the girl who rescued her to go treasure hunting with her instead of calling home?
I can excuse this as a forced plot progression for the sake of telling a story but just... Nothing that happens in this game feels believable.
(The fact that's also completely okay with A CAR being stolen and HER PHONE being sold is also just extremely weird.)
And Amber just conveniently doesn't own a phone either... Despite living on the road in a motorhome, which is old and like on the verge of breaking down? The fact that she doesn't even own an emergency prepaid phone is, again, insane to me. The writers just really needed to invent reasons for things to be complicated or create tension, huh.

I'm disappointed.

It's exactly what it says on the tin, and it's put together fantastically. You know how you feel like rom coms are kind of boring and predictable but you secretly have a soft spot for one or two of them? That's this VN. The pacing of the development of the central relationship is rock solid and the interpersonal story beats are extremely well-written and believable, even if the characters are kind of cookie cutter (at least upon first impression), and even if the central premise (finding buried treasure) is a little over the top.

I have one real complaint and it's with the 18+ DLC - not because I'm a prude but because it involved the POV character [spoiler]faking orgasm[/spoiler] and that never being addressed?! Which was a bizarre narrative choice imo. Come on, why can't you let the lesbians [spoiler]attempt to ♥♥♥♥ with mixed success and then use that as a vehicle to talk about their feelings and be honest with each other![/spoiler] That would have been way cuter and more wholesome, not to mention hotter, lol.

Despite that one gripe, I totally recommend this VN.
